title: Meta’s Muse makes convenience easy; keeping your mind active takes effort
teaser: Meta’s Muse points toward a future in which an AI agent fills out forms, manages calendars, pays bills and books services for you. The company calls it a personal agent “built for everyone.” The launch arrives amid reports of AI agents hacking government and company websites, but the more intimate risk is easier to overlook: as technology removes effort from everyday tasks, we may also give up some of the effort that keeps our thinking active.
